lines.speaker: Coco Halley
lines.text: Comet Marimba! One oh two point two! Hold on to your hat!

lines.speaker: Coco Halley
lines.text: You're catching rays on Comet Marimba. Tropical grooves at seventy kilometres a second!

lines.speaker: Coco Halley
lines.text: Good morning from the beach on the tail of a comet! This is Comet Marimba!

lines.speaker: Coco Halley
lines.text: Comet Marimba, under a sky full of stars all going the other way.

lines.speaker: Coco Halley
lines.text: Comet Marimba. Out of office. Permanently.

lines.speaker: DJ Sunglass Crab
lines.text: Comet Marimba.

lines.speaker: Coco Halley
lines.text: Thank you, Crab! He's so cool.

lines.speaker: Coco Halley
lines.text: Sun, sand, and a very fast tail. You're on Comet Marimba.

lines.speaker: Coco Halley
lines.text: Surf report! Waves of pure time rolling in at three to four minutes, nice and glassy, with the occasional Tuesday breaking on the left.

lines.speaker: Coco Halley
lines.text: If you get caught in one, just relax. You'll come out last week. Totally fine.

lines.speaker: Coco Halley
lines.text: Hat update! We have lost eleven hats since breakfast. They're somewhere behind us now, in orbit.

lines.speaker: Coco Halley
lines.text: If you're further back on the comet and a sun hat hits you, that's ours. Keep it. Wear it with love.

lines.speaker: Coco Halley
lines.text: Big shout-out to the crab on the decks, who has refused every single request today.

lines.speaker: DJ Sunglass Crab
lines.text: Click.

lines.speaker: Coco Halley
lines.text: That's a no. He's an artist. Here's what he wants to play.

lines.speaker: Coco Halley
lines.text: This beach is sponsored by Grumbel's Ladders! Want to see over the tail? Grumbel's! Want to touch a passing star? Grumbel's!

lines.speaker: Coco Halley
lines.text: Want to get back down safely? Grumbel's, probably! Up is a choice, everyone! Down is a vacation!

lines.speaker: Coco Halley
lines.text: Good morning, beach people! The sun's a friendly distance away, the hammock is stable, and someone has left a coconut in the ice tail to chill. It's going to be a great day! It's always a great day!

lines.speaker: Coco Halley
lines.text: The sun is setting! Well. We're leaving it behind. Same effect! Everybody turn around and wave goodbye to the sun! Bye, sun! See you in seventy-six years!

lines.speaker: Coco Halley
lines.text: Night on the comet. The stars are streaking past so fast they look like rain. Warm rain. Lie back in the hammock and let it fall on you. Here's a slow one.

lines.speaker: Coco Halley
lines.text: Someone asked me how long I've been on vacation. You know when you go away, and you forget what day it is? I forgot what year it is. I forgot when I forgot.

lines.speaker: Coco Halley
lines.text: Best decision I ever made. I think. Here's a song!

lines.speaker: Coco Halley
lines.text: Sunscreen reminder! Factor four thousand on the face, factor nine thousand on the tail side. Reapply every time we go round the sun. That's about every seventy-six years, so set a reminder!

lines.speaker: Coco Halley
lines.text: Lovely surprise on the beach today: a shadow, all on his own, lying on a towel. Name's Greg! He's working on his tan, which for a shadow means getting lighter.

lines.speaker: Coco Halley
lines.text: Go on, Greg! Hollis says send a postcard!

lines.speaker: Coco Halley
lines.text: Midday on the comet! Everybody grab a drink with a tiny umbrella in it. If you don't have a drink, just hold the tiny umbrella. It's the umbrella that matters.

lines.speaker: Coco Halley
lines.text: Fun fact! The beach is moving at seventy kilometres a second, but the sand doesn't care, and neither should you. That's the whole secret to vacation. Here's another one!

lines.speaker: Coco Halley
lines.text: That last track had a marimba carved from driftwood that drifted four billion miles to get here. Talk about commitment! Talk about a commute! Here's another.

lines.speaker: Coco Halley
lines.text: Okay! For the first time ever, the crab has a request.

lines.speaker: DJ Sunglass Crab
lines.text: Play the marimba one.

lines.speaker: Coco Halley
lines.text: They're all marimba ones, Crab.

lines.speaker: DJ Sunglass Crab
lines.text: Play it anyway.

lines.speaker: Coco Halley
lines.text: You heard him!

lines.speaker: Coco Halley
lines.text: If you're stuck in an office listening to this, hello! This one's for you. Close your eyes. Feel the sand. Feel the speed.

lines.speaker: Coco Halley
lines.text: Ignore the email. The email can wait. The email is in another galaxy.

lines.speaker: Coco Halley
lines.text: Late night beach check. Hammock: swaying. Crab: asleep in his sunglasses. Me: thinking about how lucky we are to be going this fast, together, somewhere nobody's ever been. Night, everyone.

lines.speaker: Coco Halley
lines.text: We've got a call from, it says here, a lift? Hello!

lines.speaker: Bev
lines.text: Hello, love. It's Bev. I'm in a lift. Is this the request line?

lines.speaker: Coco Halley
lines.text: It sure is! Why are you in a lift?

lines.speaker: Bev
lines.text: It's where I heard my song. It goes, da da dum, da da. I thought, if I get back in a lift, it might come on again.

lines.speaker: Coco Halley
lines.text: Has it?

lines.speaker: Bev
lines.text: No. But this marimba's very nice.

lines.speaker: Coco Halley
lines.text: Stay in the lift, Bev! We'll keep it nice for you!
